top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, foundational account of how collateral constraints and financial frictions amplify macroeconomic fluctuations, with sustained influence on macroeconomic theory, quantitative work, and policy analysis. Kiyotaki and Moore anchor the collateral mechanism and Gertler the related financial-accelerator formulation, though the citation should remain narrowly confined to foundational amplification mechanisms given the attribution issue involving Simon Gilchrist.
recusal_note: No connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. I disclose frequent coauthorship and IIES collegiality with Per Krusell, a committee colleague; this is not a connection to the proposed laureates.
